Run OpenAI Codex on a dedicated remote Mac mini

Reviewed: 2026-11-07 · wodeMac

A wodeMac Mac mini ships with OpenAI Codex and Claude Code preinstalled. You sign in to Codex with your own ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key, and wodeMac charges only for the machine. The Mac stays online 24/7 in California, so Codex tasks keep running after you close your laptop.

How it works

  1. Open the Mac through the preinstalled remote desktop app.
  2. Clone an authorized repository and install its dependencies.
  3. Sign in to Codex with your own ChatGPT account or set your own OpenAI API key.
  4. Run the existing build and tests first, then give Codex a clearly scoped task.
  5. Review the diff and test results before merging.

Compare Codex and Claude Code on one machine

Both agents are preinstalled, so you can give each the same task on separate branches of the same project and compare results, human intervention and cost without hardware or dependency differences.

FAQ

Is Codex preinstalled on the Mac?

Yes. Codex and Claude Code are installed at delivery, and you have admin rights to add other tools.

Does the rental include ChatGPT or API credits?

No. You use your own ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key; wodeMac does not add model fees or share accounts.

Where is the Mac hosted?

In California, USA, operated by wodeMac Inc.
